observations.note: Waiting on a test run took six turns, including a blocked chained sleep, two reads of an output file outside the workspace and a repeat run of the briefs test, because the harness gave no clean way to wait.
The agent used grep inside a shell until-loop although the prompt says to read and search with the file tools and bars listing and reading commands.

Row 4.5 was marked complete although the test checks only the prompt wording and not the rendered brief its Change cell describes, and the prompt says to leave a row unmarked when it conflicts with the plan.
The turns show no search of the spec folders for specs the change touches, which the procedure asks for before marking rows.

conformance.item: Procedure 1: read the plan and triage note
Procedure 3: test first, tests carry criterion id
Procedure 6: run only the phase's test files, not the whole suite or verification commands
Procedure 7: check specs the change touches
Procedure 8: mark completed rows in one edit after tests pass
Limits: plain single commands, file tools instead of shell for reading
